prereq.p: There must already be a version of the file in Salesforce.

step.cmd: Click Check-in from the X-Author Chatter ribbon.
Enter comments in the What changed field and click OK.

info.p: The filename cannot be changed, ensuring you are checking in a new revision of the existing file.

step.cmd: Click OK, in the confirmation dialog, which indicates the version of the file

result.p: The new version of the file is in Salesforce.
